expectation.what: of the rounds whose list holds two or more rules of SECURITY_INCIDENT, newborn not of it, at least nineteen in twenty put the newborn above every one or below every one

of the rounds whose newborn is of neither SECURITY_INCIDENT nor ONCALL_ESCALATION and whose list holds no rule of SECURITY_INCIDENT, the share above every rule of their list is at least three times as high without a rule of ONCALL_ESCALATION as with one
at reported errors, of the placements against a listed rule whose region holds the round's ticket, at least nine in ten put the newborn above

of the rounds whose list holds a rule of SECURITY_INCIDENT, newborn not of it, the share above every such rule is at least three times as high where the draft has four or more conditions and the list one or two such rules as in the others
in N r1 and N r2, of the rounds above every rule of SECURITY_INCIDENT their list holds, newborn not of it, at least three quarters above every rule of their list
in N r1 and N r2, E4's statement
